'''Luta-Vel''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was killed in the [[Nightmare Lands]] by a vicious [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] called the [[Grellik]].<ref name="TOR" />
